strings.records.kubeflow-pipelines-1031.title: Kubeflow Pipelines fixes archive expansion and log authorization
strings.records.kubeflow-pipelines-1031.body: Archive uploads are decompressed before namespace authorization and can consume server memory when reachable. Separately, callers knowing a run ID and suitable node information can retrieve logs with API-server permissions. External authentication and network controls affect reachability.
strings.records.kubeflow-pipelines-1031.action: Upgrade the product to 2.18.0 and review readLog permissions in custom roles. The narrative identifies releases through 2.17.3; the API lists commit-based Go pseudo-versions, which are not product release numbers.
strings.records.pypdf-1031.title: pypdf fixes loops and resource consumption in crafted PDFs
strings.records.pypdf-1031.body: Incomplete xref data, dictionary cloning and page trees with shared resources can trigger loops or memory consumption. Other paths affect page labels, invalid dictionaries in strict mode, encrypted PDFs with incorrect Count values and cross-reference streams.
strings.records.pypdf-1031.action: Upgrade to 6.21.4 or later to cover all seven advisories; also bound processing time and memory for untrusted PDFs.
strings.records.joi-1031.title: Joi multiple-email validation can exhaust CPU
strings.records.joi-1031.body: Long whitespace runs cause quadratic splitting in string().email({ multiple: true }), blocking the event loop in applications validating untrusted input with this option.
strings.records.joi-1031.action: Upgrade to a patched release. As a workaround put max before email and avoid abortEarly: false. Consider migrating from legacy @hapi/joi, for which the API lists no patched release.
strings.records.hapi-content-1031.title: @hapi/content multipart header parsing can cause DoS
strings.records.hapi-content-1031.body: Long malformed Content-Disposition parameters cause quadratic regex processing. Multipart-enabled hapi routes reach this parser before handlers and input validation.
strings.records.hapi-content-1031.action: Upgrade to @hapi/content 6.0.3 or later and review legacy content dependencies. Lowering payload.maxBytes only reduces the impact.
strings.records.minimatch-1031.title: minimatch pattern optimization can amplify resource use
strings.records.minimatch-1031.body: With optimizationLevel at least 2, attacker-controlled glob patterns can expand preprocessing entries and trigger costly subsequent comparisons, consuming CPU and memory.
strings.records.minimatch-1031.action: Upgrade to 11.0.1 or later and review untrusted-pattern inputs and optimization settings.
strings.records.glob-1031.title: glob traversal continues after cancellation
strings.records.glob-1031.body: Directory traversal can continue after AbortSignal cancellation or timeout. Services using cancellation as a budget for untrusted patterns or trees can accumulate background work.
strings.records.glob-1031.action: Upgrade to 14.0.2 or later and review assumptions that timeouts stop traversal costs.
strings.records.authlib-1031.title: Authlib client-management examples omit authorization binding
strings.records.authlib-1031.body: RFC 7592 examples omit binding the registration access token to the target client. Providers following those examples can permit another valid client token to read, change or delete registrations; exposure depends on application implementations.
strings.records.authlib-1031.action: Consult corrected examples in 1.9.1 or later and bind token ownership to the target client_id in custom authenticate_client and check_permission methods.
strings.records.pyasn1-1031.title: pyasn1 fixes quadratic ASN.1 decoding paths
strings.records.pyasn1-1031.body: Attacker-controlled constructed BIT STRINGs and strings, binary REALs, indefinite-length ANY values and schemaless containers can consume disproportionate CPU. Exposure includes BER/CER and some DER paths, depending on type, schema and length form.
strings.records.pyasn1-1031.action: Upgrade to 0.6.5 or later. Earlier OID and REAL-conversion fixes do not cover these decoding paths.
strings.records.node-forge-1031.title: node-forge fixes 11 crypto, certificate and TLS issues
strings.records.node-forge-1031.body: Issues include OID misencoding, prototype pollution in forge.http cookies, PEM/TLS denial of service and negative-input modInverse loops. Separate validation flaws affect zero-like AES-GCM tagLength, zero-iteration PKCS#12, CA stores with duplicate subjects and certificate chains using deprecated extension OIDs. Exposure depends on APIs and settings.
strings.records.node-forge-1031.action: Upgrade to 1.4.1 or later. Review fixed valid GCM tag lengths, untrusted PEM/PFX inputs and forge TLS usage. The basicConstraints bypass requires a trusted CA to issue a certificate containing the crafted extension.
strings.records.phpunit-1031.title: PHPUnit shared temporary directory permits local code execution
strings.records.phpunit-1031.body: During PHPT coverage runs in 13.4.0–13.4.3, another local user who creates the shared temporary directory first can replace test code and execute it as the test runner.
strings.records.phpunit-1031.action: Upgrade to 13.4.4 or later; use a private per-user TMPDIR as an interim isolation measure.
strings.records.nuxt-dev-1031.title: Nuxt development servers expose secrets and readable files
strings.records.nuxt-dev-1031.body: Network-reachable development servers can expose generated appSecret files and private config embedded in Nitro 2 development bundles. In 4.6.0–4.6.2, HMR client-error reports also allow reading files accessible to the dev process. Production builds are unaffected.
strings.records.nuxt-dev-1031.action: Upgrade nuxt and @nuxt/vite-builder to 4.6.3 or later and restrict dev-port exposure. Rotate potentially exposed credentials and invalidate dev sessions as applicable. Nuxt 3 is end of life and requires migration.
strings.records.nuxt-routing-1031.title: Nuxt dot segments bypass page-route path checks
strings.records.nuxt-routing-1031.body: In 4.6.0–4.6.2, inconsistent normalization between page rendering and Nitro can bypass path-based server/middleware and route rules. API handlers and appMiddleware applied to resolved routes are unaffected.
strings.records.nuxt-routing-1031.action: Upgrade nuxt and @nuxt/nitro-server to 4.6.3 or later; reject dot segments in an early middleware as a workaround.
strings.records.sigstore-oci-1031.title: @sigstore/oci sends registry credentials to cross-host upload locations
strings.records.sigstore-oci-1031.body: An unchecked blob-upload Location is used for a fresh PUT carrying the registry Authorization and custom authentication headers. This requires a malicious or compromised registry response. The report traces source code rather than an observed hostile-registry exchange.
strings.records.sigstore-oci-1031.action: Upgrade to 0.7.2 or later and assess credential exposure if suspicious registries were used.
strings.records.mariadb-connector-j-1031.title: MariaDB Connector/J hardens handling of hostile server replies
strings.records.mariadb-connector-j-1031.body: Server-declared lengths, integer truncation and XA recovery data can trigger allocations or exceptions. With allowLocalInfile enabled, SQL matching flaws can disclose client files; undetected charset changes affect string integrity. All require control of server-side replies or a MitM position.
strings.records.mariadb-connector-j-1031.action: Upgrade to the applicable 3.3.7, 3.4.5 or 3.5.11 line covering all five issues. Disable allowLocalInfile when unnecessary and review trusted endpoints and TLS validation.
strings.records.follow-redirects-1031.title: follow-redirects cross-realm arrays can expose custom credentials
strings.records.follow-redirects-1031.body: In 1.16.0 and 1.16.1, cross-realm sensitiveHeaders arrays are discarded, allowing declared custom credentials to follow cross-origin redirects. Built-in Authorization and Cookie protections remain effective; the report does not establish Axios exposure.
strings.records.follow-redirects-1031.action: Upgrade to 1.16.2 or later and review wrappers and vm boundaries preserving custom-header options.
strings.records.russh-1031.title: russh fixes missing signing confirmation and resource issues
strings.records.russh-1031.body: Confirm-constrained agent keys can sign without calling Agent::confirm; agent-socket peers can also grow memory with repeated constraints. A hostile SSH peer can stall writes with a 0 maximum packet size, while repeated server EXT_INFO packets grow client memory.
strings.records.russh-1031.action: Upgrade to 0.65.0 or later, check compatibility as custom confirm implementations are called again, and restrict agent forwarding.
strings.records.pageant-1031.title: pageant unchecked frame lengths permit memory consumption
strings.records.pageant-1031.body: PageantStream buffers peer-declared lengths without checking the transport’s 8 KiB limit. Oversized or incomplete frames consume retained memory when a peer controls stream bytes.
strings.records.pageant-1031.action: Upgrade to 0.2.5 or later and review untrusted stream access through SSH agent forwarding or similar paths.
strings.records.graphql-core-1031.title: GraphQL-core aborted validations retain memory
strings.records.graphql-core-1031.body: Repeated documents exceeding the validation-error limit extend a shared exception traceback, retaining documents and validation state. This affects the 3.3 line; GraphQL-core 3.2 and GraphQL.js are unaffected.
strings.records.graphql-core-1031.action: Upgrade to 3.3.1 or later. Execution-time depth or complexity limits alone do not address this validation-stage issue.
strings.records.oauthlib-1031.title: OAuthLib token grants can authorize under a different client ID
strings.records.oauthlib-1031.body: In client_credentials and password flows, a body-supplied client_id can differ from the authenticated client during authorization. Exposure requires valid lower-privilege client credentials and validators relying on the client_id argument for grants or scopes.
strings.records.oauthlib-1031.action: Upgrade to 4.0.0 or later and bind authorization to request.client, rejecting explicit ID mismatches before validation.
strings.records.openwisp-controller-1031.title: OpenWISP Controller CRL API omits organization scoping
strings.records.openwisp-controller-1031.body: Organization managers with CA-view permission can fetch another organization’s CRL by CA ID. Only issuer information and revoked serials are exposed, not private keys or modification capabilities. CRLs are public by default, making explicitly protected deployments more relevant.
strings.records.openwisp-controller-1031.action: Upgrade to 1.3.2 or later and verify organization scoping for CRL downloads.
strings.records.fiber-cors-1031.title: Fiber legacy CORS matching permits credentialed reads
strings.records.fiber-cors-1031.body: In 2.52.1 and 2.52.2, wildcard matching omits dot-boundary and scheme checks, permitting unrelated domains with matching suffixes. Applications enabling AllowCredentials can expose authenticated responses cross-origin.
strings.records.fiber-cors-1031.action: Upgrade to at least 2.52.3, preferably the latest v2. Separate matching hardening in 2.52.16 does not broaden this advisory’s affected range.
strings.records.signalk-icons-1031.title: Signal K app-store icons permit SSRF
strings.records.signalk-icons-1031.body: Absolute HTTP(S) icon URLs from listed plugins are fetched with redirects. An attacker able to list a plugin can induce server requests to internal addresses when the store is browsed. Testing exercised the real modules directly.
strings.records.signalk-icons-1031.action: Upgrade signalk-server to 2.34.0 or later and review icon destinations and internal-network egress controls.
strings.records.signalk-resources-1031.title: Signal K traversal can lead to admin takeover and code execution
strings.records.signalk-resources-1031.body: Insufficient path validation in resources and applicationData APIs permits access outside storage roots. Reading the JWT secret in security.json enables forged admin tokens and execution through an Execute provider. Anonymous access requires readonly access enabled; default deployments require a readonly token.
strings.records.signalk-resources-1031.action: Upgrade signalk-server to 2.34.0 and @signalk/resources-provider to 1.5.3 or later. Assess exposure, rotate potentially exposed JWT secrets and credentials, and inspect persisted provider settings.
strings.records.imgproxy-ico-1031.title: imgproxy ICO loading flaws corrupt heaps and allocate excessive memory
strings.records.imgproxy-ico-1031.body: Untrusted ICO sizes trigger integer overflow, out-of-bounds BMP-header reconstruction or unbounded allocation. Crafted images can crash workers; the overflow also carries potential code-execution risk, without demonstrating successful code execution.
strings.records.imgproxy-ico-1031.action: Upgrade to 4.0.17 or later to cover all three issues. Version 4.0.16 does not include the BMP-header reconstruction fix.
strings.records.anacrolix-torrent-1031.title: anacrolix/torrent deep bencode exhausts stack or CPU
strings.records.anacrolix-torrent-1031.body: Unbounded bencode nesting in crafted torrent files or peer metadata can overflow the stack. Repeated subtree parsing in v2 file trees also causes quadratic CPU consumption.
strings.records.anacrolix-torrent-1031.action: Upgrade to a version containing commit 76452a2c8a2f; the Go API identifies 1.61.1-0.20260911233437-76452a2c8a2f as patched. Review nesting and processing budgets for untrusted metadata.
strings.records.adminneo-1031.title: AdminNeo fixes 7 SQLite, cookie, XSS, CSRF and cache issues
strings.records.adminneo-1031.body: Issues include file creation or deletion by authenticated SQLite users, cookie-attribute injection through untrusted X-Forwarded-Prefix and XSS from hostile MySQL version strings. Observed CSRF tokens permit forgery, while version-cache poisoning causes persistent DoS. Code execution depends on additional conditions such as writing to a PHP-executable location.
strings.records.adminneo-1031.action: Upgrade to 5.5.1 or later. Set trusted proxy prefixes and restrict database endpoints and PHP write permissions. Version 5.5.0 fixes the cache DoS alone; the other 6 require 5.5.1.
strings.records.emissary-1031.title: Emissary navigation URL validation fix is incomplete
strings.records.emissary-1031.body: The NavAction URL regex accepts protocol-relative and single-slash forms, reported to permit open redirects or SSRF. Actual exposure depends on input and fetching paths; successful internal credential theft is not established here.
strings.records.emissary-1031.action: Upgrade to 8.51.0 or later as identified by the API and review URI parsing and allowed-host validation. Distinguish commit identifiers in the prose from package versions.
strings.records.pypi-publish-trust-1031.title: pypi-publish updates trust store after CA revocation
strings.records.pypi-publish-trust-1031.body: The notice removes the emSign root CA from the certifi trust store used by Sigstore for Trusted Publishing and Digital Attestations. The prose says before 1.14.2, but the structured API marks versions through 1.14.2 affected and 1.14.3 patched.
strings.records.pypi-publish-trust-1031.action: Use 1.14.3 or later to follow the conservative structured range and update pinned workflow references. Do not treat 1.14.2 as fixed based only on the prose.
strings.records.joserfc-1031.title: joserfc JWS and JWE resource guards are insufficient
strings.records.joserfc-1031.body: Compact JWS copies segments before size checks, creating an additional input-sized allocation. General JSON JWE has no recipient-count bound and repeats RSA decryption per recipient; verify_all_recipients=False does not reduce that CPU work.
strings.records.joserfc-1031.action: Upgrade to 1.7.6 or later to cover both issues and bound token sizes and recipient counts at application boundaries.
strings.records.soft-serve-1031.title: Soft Serve fixes stale private visibility and repository-name disclosure
strings.records.soft-serve-1031.body: A race when making public repositories private can retain stale authorization and expose later commits. Multiple processes sharing a database can stay stale without a race. Separate HTTP response differences and go-get handling disclose private names and URLs, but not contents on their own.
strings.records.soft-serve-1031.action: Upgrade to 0.12.3 or later. Restarting clears stale visibility but does not prevent recurrence; create new repositories private from the outset as an interim measure.
strings.records.nx-java-plugins-1031.title: Nx Maven and Gradle plugin options permit command injection
strings.records.nx-java-plugins-1031.body: In workspaces registering affected plugins, crafted nx.json options enter shell-based analyzer commands. An ordinary nx command then executes code as the caller. Additional exposure is narrow where build files are already trusted to execute code, but matters in CI trusting editable nx.json separately.
strings.records.nx-java-plugins-1031.action: Upgrade nx and the affected @nx/maven or @nx/gradle plugin together to 22.7.9 or 23.1.2 or later. Updating only the plugin is insufficient.
strings.records.malware-1031.title: Malicious packages: check each advisory published in this window
strings.records.malware-1031.body: Malware advisories published in this window are retained by package. Similar names do not establish infection or a shared campaign, and an absent fixed version does not establish a safe release.
strings.records.malware-1031.action: Check dependency lockfiles and build history, isolate and remove matching packages, and investigate credential exposure if they were executed.
strings.records.kev-ivanti-1031.title: Ivanti Connect Secure: KEV adds exploitation evidence; separate triage from patching
strings.records.kev-ivanti-1031.body: CISA catalog 2026.10.30 contains 1,766 entries. CVE-2026-118527 concerns a remote authenticated attacker uploading files to a known path; CVE-2026-111357 concerns local authenticated privilege escalation. The entries describe chaining with CVE-2026-104935. Addition dates do not establish initial disclosure or compromise of every deployment.
strings.records.kev-ivanti-1031.action: Check vendor-specific patches, mitigations and compromise investigation. KEV due dates are 2026-11-13 for CVE-2026-118527 and 2026-11-02 for CVE-2026-111357; the latter has forensicTriage Yes. Federal agency deadlines are not universal legal deadlines. The Ivanti advisory body could not be retrieved, so a fixed-version mapping was not verified in this update.
strings.records.apache-mina-118636.title: Apache MINA 3.0 codec: deserialization from untrusted peers
strings.records.apache-mina-118636.body: The Apache CNA describes CVE-2026-118636: JavaNativeMessageDecoder calls ObjectInputStream.readObject() without a class filter, allowing gadget-chain RCE in applications that expose this decoder to untrusted peers. The 3.0 branch is inactive, no fixed release is planned, and the latest 2.2.X branch is recommended. NVD registration was on 10/31 at 21:16:53 UTC; this is not confirmation of exploitation.
strings.records.apache-mina-118636.action: Check use of the affected codec and reachability from external peers; prevent untrusted input from reaching it. Rather than waiting for a 3.0 fix, assess compatibility and migrate to the latest 2.2.X branch. Check the original affected-version fields against your artifacts.
strings.records.apache-mina-118636.time: 2026-10-31T20:17:11.191Z / Apache CNA publication; NVD registration at 21:16:53 UTC
strings.records.pystr-codec-1101.title: pystr-codec: reported credential theft and persistence at Python startup
strings.records.pystr-codec-1101.body: The researcher report indexed by OpenSSF describes a PTH file that runs obfuscated JavaScript through Bun at Python startup, steals credentials, establishes persistence and attempts propagation. It also reports destructive local actions after credential invalidation. The Miasma-family relationship is a researcher assessment; affected-machine counts are unconfirmed.
strings.records.pystr-codec-1101.action: Isolate environments that executed affected versions and preserve evidence. Revoke and replace credentials from a separate trusted environment, investigate persistence and rebuild. Package removal alone does not establish safety.
strings.records.is-it-ai-chain-1101.title: is-it-ai and related packages: remote execution through selected dependency versions
strings.records.is-it-ai-chain-1101.body: The researcher report describes code hidden in selected dependency versions that fingerprints the environment, contacts a remote server and downloads and executes a returned URL. It identifies triggers in skills-analyzer and md-to-slides 0.1.1 and multi-convert 0.1.4, while structured affected ranges also include other releases described as cover. Trigger conditions and the affected-version list are distinct.
strings.records.is-it-ai-chain-1101.action: Check direct and transitive dependencies and installation history; isolate and investigate affected environments. Account for possible remote execution when revoking and replacing credentials from another environment. A missing fixed-version entry does not establish a safe release.
strings.records.privacypass-py-1101.title: privacypass-py: credential exfiltration during build, install and import
strings.records.privacypass-py-1101.body: The Amazon Inspector record reports code posing as cryptographic primitives that sends host information and credential-bearing environment variables externally during build or install and again at import. The import path also runs outside pip build isolation. The name does not establish compromise of the legitimate Privacy Pass project.
strings.records.privacypass-py-1101.action: Check installation and import history for affected versions. Isolate affected environments and revoke and replace credentials from another environment. Do not rely only on build isolation or contact the reported collection endpoint to test it.
strings.records.npm-probes-1101.title: hs-framework and @axon-web/icons: external tarball and DNS reporting
strings.records.npm-probes-1101.body: hs-framework is reported to depend directly on an external HTTPS tarball, allowing delivery of changing content and lifecycle scripts. @axon-web/icons reportedly sends hostname and username through DNS at require time and prints credential-related environment-variable names to standard output. Enumerating names does not establish transmission of their values.
strings.records.npm-probes-1101.action: Check affected versions, lockfile resolved and integrity entries, execution history and DNS logs. Isolate and investigate affected environments; do not install suspect packages or tarballs as a test.
strings.records.npm-malware-1101.title: 2 npm packages: advisories call for investigating installations as compromised

strings.records.ibm-apic-auth-1108.body: The records cover other-user access tokens and administrative control through hard-coded credentials. CVE-2026-16720 and CVE-2026-17403 affect 10.0.8.0–10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0–12.1.1.2. CVE-2026-17360 affects 12.1.0.0–12.1.1.2. strings.records.ibm-apic-execution-1108.body: CVE-2026-17340 covers path-traversal code execution in 12.1.0.0–12.1.1.2; CVE-2026-17408 covers OS-command handling in 10.0.8.0–10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0–12.1.1.2. strings.records.ibm-apic-execution-1108.action: Deploy 10.0.8.13 or 12.1.1.3 and review gateway and management exposure, child processes, file changes and audit logs. Deployment alone does not establish absence of earlier unauthorized execution.
strings.records.keycloak-client-policy-1108.titl: Keycloak: client-management roles reach JavaScript policies
strings.records.keycloak-client-policy-1108.body: Session state during client creation or import with authorization services enabled permits inline JavaScript policy upload restrictions to be bypassed. Authenticated delegated client-management privileges are required. Red Hat lists CVSS 9.1 and Important, marks packages Affected and supplies no fixed release. Its public_date is 2026-01-07, differing from this NVD registration date.
strings.records.keycloak-client-policy-1108.acti: Review delegated manage-clients permissions, client imports and policy changes. Track product-specific Red Hat fixes without inventing a release. Default script restrictions alone do not establish protection against this path.
strings.records.fiber-admin-1108.title: Fiber Admin: error-page configuration and a race condition
strings.records.fiber-admin-1108.body: Before 4.0.1, an enabled custom database error page and a race with an administrator saving settings allow a request header to be written into a PHP file. Authentication is not required, but configuration and race prerequisites matter. WPScan lists 4.0.1 as fixed and 11/5 as initial publication.
strings.records.fiber-admin-1108.action: Update to a release containing the 4.0.1 fix and inspect the custom database error-page setting and generated PHP files. Disabling a feature is distinct from completed patch deployment; correlate settings changes with access logs.
strings.records.latepoint-reset-1108.title: LatePoint: reset-token values become SQL conditions
strings.records.latepoint-reset-1108.body: The NVD CNA description covers the booking plugin through 5.7.6: reset values can be treated as SQL conditions. Customer takeover exposes bookings and personal data, with linked WordPress accounts affected depending on configuration. The 5.7.5 scalar check is insufficient. Wordfence returned HTTP success with an empty body, so its text did not verify a fixed release.
strings.records.latepoint-reset-1108.action: Check official LatePoint releases and CNA remediation guidance and verify the deployed fix. Do not assert a minimum fixed release from the bodies verified here. Investigate resets, customer-account changes and booking-data access.

strings.records.woocommerce-registration-1108.ac: Review checkout account-creation settings and plugin release guidance, then verify a running build containing the fix. Investigate administrator creation and role changes; revoke unnecessary privileged accounts and sessions.

records.title: GraphQL-core aborted validations retain memory

records.action: Upgrade to 3.3.1 or later. Execution-time depth or complexity limits alone do not address this validation-stage issue.

advisories.summary: GraphQL-core has denial of service via memory leak in aborted validations

records.title: OAuthLib token grants can authorize under a different client ID
records.body: In client_credentials and password flows, a body-supplied client_id can differ from the authenticated client during authorization. Exposure requires valid lower-privilege client credentials and validators relying on the client_id argument for grants or scopes.
records.action: Upgrade to 4.0.0 or later and bind authorization to request.client, rejecting explicit ID mismatches before validation.

records.title: IBM API Connect: authentication and hard-coded credentials

records.title: IBM API Connect: unauthenticated execution and release-line fixes

IBM assigns both CVSS 9.8. Keep these separate from other CVEs requiring authenticated users. Selected CVEs are not an exhaustive list of the bulletins.

records.title: Keycloak: client-management roles reach JavaScript policies
records.body: Session state during client creation or import with authorization services enabled permits inline JavaScript policy upload restrictions to be bypassed. Authenticated delegated client-management privileges are required. Red Hat lists CVSS 9.1 and Important, marks packages Affected and supplies no fixed release. Its public_date is 2026-01-07, differing from this NVD registration date.
records.action: Review delegated manage-clients permissions, client imports and policy changes. Track product-specific Red Hat fixes without inventing a release. Default script restrictions alone do not establish protection against this path.

records.title: Fiber Admin: error-page configuration and a race condition
records.body: Before 4.0.1, an enabled custom database error page and a race with an administrator saving settings allow a request header to be written into a PHP file. Authentication is not required, but configuration and race prerequisites matter. WPScan lists 4.0.1 as fixed and 11/5 as initial publication.
records.action: Update to a release containing the 4.0.1 fix and inspect the custom database error-page setting and generated PHP files. Disabling a feature is distinct from completed patch deployment; correlate settings changes with access logs.

records.title: LatePoint: reset-token values become SQL conditions
records.body: The NVD CNA description covers the booking plugin through 5.7.6: reset values can be treated as SQL conditions. Customer takeover exposes bookings and personal data, with linked WordPress accounts affected depending on configuration. The 5.7.5 scalar check is insufficient. Wordfence returned HTTP success with an empty body, so its text did not verify a fixed release.
records.action: Check official LatePoint releases and CNA remediation guidance and verify the deployed fix. Do not assert a minimum fixed release from the bodies verified here. Investigate resets, customer-account changes and booking-data access.

records.title: WooCommerce Registration Form: checkout role authorization
records.body: The NVD CNA description reports a missing checkout-registration role allowlist through 1.1.4, permitting unauthenticated administrator escalation. My Account checks do not establish checkout safety. A changeset references 1.1.5, but Wordfence’s empty body does not verify a shipped fixed release.
records.action: Review checkout account-creation settings and plugin release guidance, then verify a running build containing the fix. Investigate administrator creation and role changes; revoke unnecessary privileged accounts and sessions.
